name: update_attack_challenge_mode
description:
Enable or disable Attack Challenge mode for a project by setting attackModeEnabled, optionally with attackModeActiveUntil to set when it stops being active. This changes how the project's live traffic is protected.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/security/attack-mode --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
